title: DurabRing
description: Draws a thin durability ring around your crosshair for the held tool, weapon, or armor piece. Full green circle that shrinks and turns red as the item wears out, so you see the warning in your line of sight. Toggle with V.
body:
**DurabRing** puts your held item's durability where your eyes already are: as a thin colored ring drawn around the crosshair. While you're holding a tool, weapon, or any item with finite durability, a full green ring traces around the crosshair. As the item takes damage, the arc shrinks (clockwise from the top) and shifts through yellow to red. Below 10% remaining, a small red **percentage** appears just under the crosshair so you don't get caught mid-swing.

### What it shows
- **Full green ring** = item near full durability.
- **Shrinking yellow arc** = item is halfway gone.
- **Tiny red arc + "8%" label** = item is about to break - switch out or repair.
- Nothing on screen when you're empty-handed or holding something that doesn't take damage.

### Why it's different
The vanilla durability bar lives at the bottom of the hotbar - fine when standing still, useless when you're swinging a sword in combat or mining a vein with your eyes locked on the crosshair. DurabRing keeps the information *in your line of sight*, exactly where you're already looking, and only when it's relevant (held damageable items).

### Controls
- **V** - toggle the ring on / off (default: on)

### Compatibility
Works on **Minecraft 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, and 1.21.11** (Fabric Loader 0.16+). One JAR for all four versions - install alongside Fabric API and drop into your `mods/` folder.

- Pure client-side - install only on the client, works on any server, no anti-cheat impact.
- Hides automatically when you press **F1** or open any screen.
- Zero config files; nothing to set up.
